SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME, KEY_1 AS LEGACY_PO_NO FROM KEPTRXL WHERE 1=1 AND DOC_NAME = 'PO' GROUP BY DOC_NAME, KEY_1
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'PSAN' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, 1 AS SEQ, 'C' AS STATUS, ISNULL(A.KEY_1,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, ISNULL(B.LEGACY_PO_SEQ,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, ISNULL(B.BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, 'KRW' AS CURRENCY_CODE, ISNULL(B.UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, ISNULL(B.ITEM_QTY,0) AS ITEM_QTY, ISNULL((B.ITEM_AMT),0) AS ITEM_AMT, ISNULL(B.ADD_DATE,' ') AS ADD_DATE, ISNULL(B.RD_DATE,' ') AS RD_DATE, ISNULL(B.DELY_TO_LOCATION,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, ISNULL(B.PURCHASER_USER_ID,' ') AS REQ_USER_ID, ' ' AS LEGACY_PR_NO, ISNULL(B.REQ_USER_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME, ISNULL(B.REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME, ISNULL(B.REQ_USER_TEL,' ') AS REQ_USER_TEL, ISNULL(B.REMARK,' ') AS REMARK FROM KEPTRXL A, KEP_PO_V B WHERE A.DOC_NAME = 'PO' AND A.KEY_1 = B.LEGACY_PO_NO AND A.KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'PSAN' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, 0 AS SEQ, 'D' AS STATUS, ISNULL(A.KEY_1,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, ' ' AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, ' ' AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, 'KRW' AS CURRENCY_CODE, 0 AS UNIT_PRICE," 0 AS ITEM_QTY, 0 AS ITEM_AMT, ' ' AS ADD_DATE, ' ' AS RD_DATE, ' ' AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, ' ' AS PURCHASER_USER_ID, ' ' AS LEGACY_PR_NO, ' ' AS REQ_USER_NAME, ' ' AS REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME, ' ' AS REQ_USER_TEL, ' ' AS REMARK FROM KEPTRXL A WHERE A.DOC_NAME = 'PO' AND A.KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' ) WHERE SEQ = (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(T.LEGACY_PO_NO)=0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END FROM KEP_PO_V T WHERE T.LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$') ORDER BY SEQ, LEGACY_PO_NO, BUYER_ITEM_NO
DELETE KEPTRXL WHERE 1=1 AND DOC_NAME = 'PO' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$'
